title: Food - Worldwide
highlights: Revenue in the Food Market is projected to reach US$904.76bn in 2026.
Revenue is expected to show an annual growth rate (CAGR 2026-2030) of 9.42%, resulting in a projected market volume of US$1.30tn by 2030.
With a projected market volume of US$405.20bn in 2026, most revenue is generated China.
In the Food Market, the number of buyers is expected to amount to 1.6bn users by 2030.
Buyer penetration will be 21.6% in 2026 and is expected to hit 23.2% by 2030.
The average revenue per buyer (ARPB) is expected to amount to US$647.42.
